title: Evaluation of towers has an exact right adjoint
statement:
For $n\geq1$ and an $\mathcal O_{E,T}/\ell^n$-module sheaf $J$ on $T_{\mathrm{proét}}$,
let $r_nJ\in\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E)$ be the tower with $(r_nJ)_r=J$ for
$r\geq n$ (an $\mathcal O_{E,T}/\ell^r$-module by restriction of scalars along
$\mathcal O_{E,T}/\ell^r\to\mathcal O_{E,T}/\ell^n$), $(r_nJ)_r=0$ for $r<n$,
identity transitions $(r_nJ)_{r+1}\to(r_nJ)_r$ for $r\geq n$ and zero
transitions below. Then $r_n$ is an exact functor, right adjoint to evaluation
$C_\bullet\mapsto C_n$. Consequently $r_n$ preserves injective objects, and
every tower $C_\bullet$ embeds into $\prod_{n\geq1}r_nJ_n$ for injective
$\mathcal O_{E,T}/\ell^n$-modules $J_n\supset C_n$.

proof.text: *Well-defined.* The transitions are linear over the reduction maps: for $r\geq n$ the identity $J\to J$ is linear over $\mathcal O/\ell^{r+1}\to\mathcal O/\ell^r$ since both actions factor through $\mathcal O/\ell^n$; all transitions with target level $r<n$ are zero; the boundary $r=n-1$ occurs only when $n>1$. This constructs an object of the tower category described in [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. For a module-sheaf morphism $f:J\to J\prime$, set $(r_nf)_r=f$ for $r\geq n$ and zero below. These maps commute with the transitions, and identities and compositions are respected levelwise, defining the functor $r_n$.

*Adjunction.* Let $\phi:C_\bullet\to r_nJ$ be a map of towers. Its components for $r<n$ are zero. For $r\geq n$, compatibility with transitions gives $\phi_r=\phi_n\circ(C_r\to C_n)$, the transition from level $r$ down to level $n$ (the transitions of $r_nJ$ are identities). Conversely, for any $\mathcal O_{E,T}/\ell^n$-linear $\psi:C_n\to J$, define $\phi_r=0$ for $r<n$ and $\phi_r=\psi\circ(C_r\to C_n)$ for $r\geq n$. This family commutes with the transitions: for $r\geq n$ by construction, and, when $n>1$, at $r=n-1$ because the target transition $(r_nJ)_n\to(r_nJ)_{n-1}=0$ is zero. The component at $n$ of this family is $\psi$, since $C_n\to C_n$ is the identity, and the displayed compatibility determines every component of any tower map. The two constructions are therefore inverse. Precomposing by a tower map $a:C\prime_\bullet\to C_\bullet$ replaces $\psi$ by $\psi a_n$, because $a_n(C\prime_r\to C\prime_n)=(C_r\to C_n)a_r$; postcomposing by $b:J\to J\prime$ replaces it by $b\psi$ at every level. Thus $\operatorname{Hom}(C_\bullet,r_nJ)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(C_n,J)$ naturally, so $r_n$ is right adjoint to evaluation at $n$.

*Exactness.* Kernels and cokernels in the tower category are computed levelwise by [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. At each level the functor $r_n$ is either restriction of scalars along a quotient-ring map, which preserves kernels and cokernels because these are the sectionwise kernel and sheafification of the sectionwise cokernel of the unchanged underlying map [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], or the zero functor; therefore $r_n$ is exact.

*Preservation of injectives.* Evaluation at $n$ is exact by [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian], and the preceding step shows that $r_n$ is its right adjoint. The Mathlib leaf [lem-sp-right-adjoint-preserves-injectives] therefore implies that $r_n$ sends every injective $\mathcal O_{E,T}/\ell^n$-module sheaf to an injective tower.

*Embedding into products.* Use the small skeleton and universes specified in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Since $\mathcal O_{E,T}/\ell^n$ is a sheaf of commutative rings, [lem-pur-ringed-site-grothendieck-abelian] applies to its module-sheaf category. Together with the Mathlib leaf [lem-sp-grothendieck-enough-injectives], this gives, for each $n$, a monomorphism $i_n:C_n\hookrightarrow J_n$ with $J_n$ injective. The adjunction gives the tower map with component $i_n(C_r\to C_n)$ at $r\geq n$ and zero at $r<n$.

Construct $P_r=\prod_{1\leq n\leq r}J_n$ with each $J_n$ regarded as an $\mathcal O_{E,T}/\ell^r$-module by restriction along the reduction map. Sections, restrictions and operations are coordinatewise; compatible sections glue uniquely in each coordinate, so this is a module sheaf. Define $P_{r+1}\to P_r$ by dropping the last coordinate. These maps are semilinear over reduction since each retained coordinate acts through $\mathcal O_{E,T}/\ell^n$, so $P_\bullet$ is a tower. For each $n$, its $n$-th projection at levels $r\geq n$ and zero map at $r<n$ give a tower map $P_\bullet\to r_nJ_n$. Given maps $D_\bullet\to r_nJ_n$ for all $n$, form at level $r$ the tuple of their components with $n\leq r$. Tower compatibility makes these tuples commute with the dropping transitions, and each coordinate is forced by its projection. This proves the product universal property $P_\bullet=\prod_{n\geq1}r_nJ_n$ without assuming products of towers are levelwise.

The induced map $C_\bullet\to P_\bullet$ has components $x\mapsto(i_n(C_r\to C_n)(x))_{1\leq n\leq r}$. Its last coordinate is $i_r$, so its kernel at level $r$ is zero. Kernels in the tower category are levelwise [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian], hence this map is a monomorphism of towers.
